what: Station-value rule extended per 03-PLAN: at a non-CLI station with a GHCN-D USW record, IEM is compared with GHCN-D and replaced by GHCN-D if they differ on more than 2 % of days (same thresholds as the CLI check). Stations with neither (JRB, MMU, GYY, LOM, CKZ, IGQ, 06C; BLM in the outer ring) stay on IEM, unchecked.

Data-quality result (before any HE): every checked station fails the 2 % tmax check (IEM 0.4-0.9 F low on 39-68 % of days before 2025-10, 0-9 % after), so all CLI stations use CLI tmax and all non-CLI stations with a USW record use GHCN-D tmax; precip stays on IEM everywhere (0-1.5 % mismatch). The GHCN-D records for HST, WRI and JOT are empty in 2024 (train coverage 0 %), so these three have no train data. Frozen PC1 fits therefore give zero weight to any input with less than 50 % train coverage (HST in the MIA network, WRI in the TTN network) instead of dropping every train day. Decided before any HE was computed.
pre_freeze: PC1 fitted on train days with all inputs present
